name: Helping The Sick
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively care for the sick and needy as an expression of godly compassion and obedience. Jesus commands healing and generosity, reminding us to freely give as we have freely received, embodying the Golden Rule in our service to others. Helping those in physical need reflects kindness to the poor, which Proverbs shows is lending to the Lord Himself, while Isaiah assures us of God's sustaining strength as we serve. Practical hospitality and meeting the necessities of fellow believers further demonstrate Christ-centered love in action.
